regime_context: The detector shows Base Metals & Copper as the dominant theme with high durability and breadth, while the absolute-trend gate historically reduced drawdowns in this market. Precious metals themes also rank strongly. Laggards like Technology and Consumer Staples have negative momentum and are either crowded or mean-reverting, but the rotation is broad and no handoff is signaled.

A trend-following allocation aligns with the detector’s risk-control edge, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Copper prices could fall sharply if Chinese demand weakens or global industrial activity slows, breaking the trend regime suddenly.
